title: Mini Test 01 (mẫu)
description: Đề mẫu ngắn để kiểm tra app: Part 5, 6, 7.

questions.content: All employees are required to submit their expense reports ------- the end of the month.
questions.explanation: "by + mốc thời gian" = trước/chậm nhất là. "until" diễn tả hành động kéo dài liên tục, không hợp với "submit".

questions.content: The new software has made the billing process significantly more -------.
questions.explanation: Sau "more" (so sánh hơn) và sau "made ... " cần tính từ bổ nghĩa cho tân ngữ → efficient.

questions.content: Ms. Tanaka will be out of the office next week, so please direct any questions to ------- assistant.
questions.explanation: Trước danh từ "assistant" cần tính từ sở hữu → her.

questions.content: ------- the heavy rain, the outdoor product launch went ahead as planned.
questions.explanation: Theo sau là cụm danh từ (the heavy rain) → dùng giới từ "Despite". "Although" cần mệnh đề.

questions.content: Applicants must have at least three years of ------- experience in project management.
questions.explanation: Trước danh từ "experience" cần tính từ → relevant (liên quan).

groups.passage:
To: All staff
From: Facilities Department
Subject: Parking lot repairs

Please be advised that the north parking lot will be closed from Monday, May 4, ---(131)--- Friday, May 8, for resurfacing. During this time, employees ---(132)--- to use the south lot or the public garage on Elm Street. ---(133)---. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your ---(134)--- while this important work is completed.

questions.explanation: Nhân viên ĐƯỢC khuyến khích → bị động "are encouraged".

options: Parking fees at the garage will be reimbursed upon presentation of a receipt.
The north lot was built more than twenty years ago.
Our cafeteria will offer a new menu next month.
Please submit your vacation requests early.
questions.explanation: Câu A liên kết trực tiếp với việc gửi xe ở bãi công cộng vừa nhắc tới.
Sau tính từ sở hữu "your" cần danh từ → patience (sự kiên nhẫn).

groups.passage:
GREENLEAF CATERING

Now booking for summer events!

Whether you are planning a company picnic, a client reception, or a team lunch, Greenleaf Catering has a menu to suit your needs. All dishes are prepared with locally sourced ingredients.

- Orders for 50 guests or more receive a 10% discount.
- Free delivery within the city limits.
- Orders must be placed at least five business days in advance.

Call 555-0142 or visit www.greenleafcatering.com to view our full menu.

questions.explanation: "Greenleaf Catering ... company picnic, client reception" → dịch vụ ăn uống cho sự kiện.

questions.content: How can customers receive a discount?
options: By ordering five days in advance
By ordering for a large group
questions.explanation: "Orders for 50 guests or more receive a 10% discount."

questions.content: What is indicated about the ingredients?
questions.explanation: "locally sourced ingredients" = nguyên liệu từ nhà cung cấp địa phương.
